status: Whole parameter records retained at their paths; only external JSON whitespace changes

original_history_binding: Original whole versions recoverable at fixed commit/path or original Git blob. All old internal whole references keep their historical meaning; readers demanding them restore entire originals before consumption. Current byte identity is separately mapped.
